$1,000,000 Pyramid, The.name: The $1,000,000 Pyramid
$1,000,000 Pyramid, The.summary: There's a lot of money to be won in this Wii title based on the classic TV game show.

Brothers in Arms - Double Time.name: Brothers in Arms: Double Time
Brothers in Arms - Double Time.summary:
The title is a compilation of the first two Brothers in Arms games, Brothers in Arms: Road to Hill 30 and Brothers in Arms: Earned in Blood and was developed by Gearbox Software and published by Ubisoft. It features 31 levels set during the Battle of Normandy.

The Wii version of the game uses the motion sensing abilities of the Wii Remote and the Nunchuk attachment for issuing battle gestures and squad commands during gameplay. It lacks any multiplayer features.

Green Lantern - Rise of the Manhunters.name: Green Lantern: Rise of the Manhunters
Green Lantern - Rise of the Manhunters.summary: Green Lantern: Rise of the Manhunters is a Wii action video game, the first based on DC Comics' Green Lantern.

Indianapolis 500 Legends.name: Indianapolis 500 Legends
Indianapolis 500 Legends.summary: Fight to the finish in a hand-built speed machine racing seven inches off the ground at nearly 180 mph through a moving minefield of crashes, spinning cars, rolling tires, and 32 rivals on the world's most famous racetrack in Indianapolis 500 Legends, an arcade-style racing experience set in a dynamic era spanning 1961-1971. Players will experience the traditions, rivalries, terrifying speeds, jaw-dropping maneuvers and infamous events that characterized this historic period at the world-famous Indianapolis 500 race.

Michael Jackson - The Experience.name: Michael Jackson: The Experience
Michael Jackson - The Experience.summary:
Relive the magic and rock your body to decades of iconic tracks. This unique interactive experience will immerse you in the world of the King of Pop.

With Michael Jackson The Experience, dance to a wide variety of songs from Michael Jackson’s extensive catalogue including some of his greatest hits like Beat It and Billie Jean, while having a blast singing and mastering his incredible dance routines and signature moves!

Discover and perform in soulful environments inspired by Michael Jackson’s ground-breaking music videos and stage performances.
